phases.accountable: Product lead, with the CS lead for test suppliers
phases.wfOwner: Neehar Swali (Product); Oliver Albee / TJ Spero (CS)
checklist: 3 or more test suppliers completed signup, payment and product activation without engineering workarounds
Fee display verified on every account type

phases.name: Enablement
checklist: Partner has approved the asset kit
KB is live in all launch languages
Every internal team trained, attendance logged
phases.wf: Sep 29 internal enablement drew feedback: no clear "why", unclear audience, no objection handling, landed at month-end [C]. KB (EN, ZH) published Oct 5 [C]. Wayfair trained SAMs Oct 1 [C].

phases.name: Recruitment and Launch
checklist: Readiness scorecard 85% or higher
No red must-haves
Both launch dates clear of partner code freezes, regional holidays and month-end
phases.wf: Connection opened to all suppliers Oct 5. Marketing launch Oct 13 at 8am ET, Wayfair leading [C]. APAC holiday Oct 1 to 7 ran over the soft launch [C]. Scored on Oct 5, Wayfair would have landed around 55 to 60% [I].

phases.name: Hypercare
phases.accountable: Launch PM, with the CS lead
checklist: 2 straight weeks with no Sev1 or Sev2
Partner follow-up list closed or scheduled
Activation on pace against target
phases.wf: Hypercare is live. Emily's Oct 14 list is open, 10 to 13% order-feed gap, CJ price corrections blocked by Wayfair code freeze [C]. Oct 13: 151 activations vs October target of 45 [C].

phases.name: Steady State
checklist: First monthly KPI report delivered and accepted
Invoicing on schedule
Retro done and playbook updated
phases.wf: KPI: at least $7.5M Tracked GMV a month for 2 straight months, first period months 7 to 18 after commencement [C].
